prompts.title: Why Michigan (your school or college)
prompts.text: Describe the unique qualities that attract you to the specific undergraduate college or school (including preferred admission and dual degree programs) to which you are applying at the University of Michigan. How would that curriculum support your interests?
prompts.note: Required for all first-year applicants; answered about the unit applied to (for Urban Technology applicants, Taubman College). admissions.umich.edu answers automated clients with a Cloudflare bot challenge (fetch-text and WebFetch both refused with HTTP 403), so the text could not be confirmed on the official page from this environment. Search results for the official essay-questions page show this wording and word range, and two independent 2026-27 essay guides reproduce the identical prompt (one reports checking U-M's page on 2026-09-24 and that the prompts are unchanged from 2025-26). Re-confirm on the official page before marking verified.

prompts.title: Leaders and citizens (how you will contribute)
prompts.text: At the University of Michigan, we are focused on developing leaders and citizens who will challenge the present and enrich the future. In your essay, share with us how you are prepared to contribute to these goals. This could include the people, places, experiences, or aspirations that have shaped your journey and future plans.
